token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token,quote) UniSwapV2 pair has been deployed before graduation

attacker_quote_wei_per_token.meaning: amount of quote the attacker supplies to each newly created token (1 wei)

graduation_completed.meaning: graduation transaction completes without reverting, depositing 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool

assumptions: The attacker needs no special authorization to deploy the pair or call sync.
The 1 wei deposit together with sync is what sets reserveA to 1 wei and triggers the failure.
Token ordering (which token is tokenA) is example-dependent and not fixed.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the 'massive attack' magnitude beyond 1 wei of quote per newly created token; the impact's scale is qualitative.

limitations: The impact is formalized as failure of graduation completion; the per-token 1 wei supply is carried as an observable but its aggregate 'massive' scale is not numerically defined.
Other impacts (permanent DoS, users forced to withdraw quote) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered by this plan.
